subtitle: Habits that stick, then fly
promotionalText: Most habit apps want you forever. Fledge fills in three habits from Apple Health and lets each one go once it sticks, about 66 days on average.
description:
Fledge is the habit tracker that lets go.

Most habit apps want you forever. Fledge tracks three habits at a time, fills them in from Apple Health, and graduates each one once it sticks, about 66 days on average. Then it leaves your list and keeps tracking quietly in the background.

DONE FOR YOU
• Walking, exercise, sleep, mindful minutes, water, daylight, standing and workouts complete themselves from Apple Health. No logging.
• Anything else takes one tap: in the app, on a widget, the Lock Screen, Control Center or with Siri.

A HEAD START FROM YOUR OWN DATA
• Add a habit and see your last 30 days from Apple Health right away.
• Already doing it most days? Fledge tells you, so you can aim higher or pick something new.

THREE AT A TIME, THEN THEY FLY
• Your nest holds three habits. Focus beats a list of twenty.
• A habit can graduate from day 30, once you've met it on 80% of days. Fledge shows the day it's on track to fly.
• Flown habits keep tracking quietly. If one slips, Fledge nudges you once.

NO GUILT
• Rest days are built in. One missed day costs nothing, and there are no red failure screens.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account. Apple Health data stays on your device and is never uploaded.

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
• Home Screen widgets in every size, Lock Screen widgets, StandBy, Control Center and Siri. Native on iPad, too.

FLEDGE PRO
Free includes three habits, one of them filled in from Apple Health. Pro lets all three fill in by themselves and adds every widget size, the Lock Screen widgets, app icons and CSV export. Yearly with a 7-day free trial, monthly, or once for life.
